Rank 03 - Food

Restaurant Table QR Order and Kitchen Display

A restaurant loses time when staff repeat the menu, table status is unclear, and kitchen orders are shouted or written badly.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 12,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 700Recommended monthly charge

BDT 700/month is reasonable because restaurants can pay more when the system touches table turnover, menu control, and kitchen speed.

8.8Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 12,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 700Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 20,400,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Food-service establishments crossed 436,000 in the 2021 BBS survey. A 1,000-restaurant target is less than 0.25 percent of that base.

Customers do not know available items. Staff forget table order details. Owners cannot see which table is active. Kitchen receives messy notes.

Customers scan, see available items, order faster, and the kitchen gets a clean queue.

Validation signals

  • Food-service count is large and growing.
  • QR menu behavior is familiar after mobile payments and delivery apps.
  • Rush-hour workflow has obvious pain.
  • Hardware and printer support can become a pro tier.

MVP modules

  • QR menu per table
  • Live table status
  • 30-60 second table hold
  • Waiter mode
  • Kitchen order display
  • Item available/unavailable toggle
  • Bill print/share and daily cash close

Do not build first

  • Do not build food delivery marketplace.
  • Do not build complex inventory first.
  • Do not require customers to install an app.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Pilot with 5 small restaurants that already have table service.
  • Use laminated table QR cards.
  • Test rush-hour kitchen display.
  • Charge setup after one week if staff keeps using it.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • If the UI is slow, staff will abandon it.
  • Printer and network issues create support load.
  • Restaurants may ask for custom menu design.
Mitigations
  • Keep waiter mode as fast as paper.
  • Sell hardware setup separately.
  • Use fixed menu templates.
